comparison.objective: Pack four peaches into tray cups without dropping or bruising them.
comparison.physical_skill: Gentle grasping, transport, supported placement, and bimanual workspace use.
comparison.success_condition: All four peaches in cups; a release-to-rest fall of at least 1.5 cm permanently scores zero.
comparison.reason: Tests low-impact delicate placement—the opposite force regime from controlled notch fracture—and has no tool alignment or fragment recovery. Specs are absent, but the drop threshold is explicit.
